死亡森林有不少的灵兽，等级不算高，时笙遇到了，就只当是练手，不过那些灵兽死得很惨就对了。

一路进去，总算找到了那棵红色的树。

真的是红色的，上上下下，里里外外，都特么是红色，灰常的闪眼。

她为什么知道里面是红的？

哦，她把树砍了。

按照尿性这棵树应该是特殊道具的，可是直到时笙将它分尸了，也没什么异常。

难道是因为本宝宝不是女主？没有自带事故体？

现在连道具的套路都这么深了吗？可怕！

树：“……”妈的你倒是给个发挥的机会啊，一上来就把它砍了，它还没反应过来好嘛！

砍了树，时笙就坐到躺在地上的树干上，仰头望天——等男主！

她只知道女主是在这棵树底下遇到女主的，但是男主如何出现在这里的，那就只有作者知道了。

时笙等得都快成望夫石了，也没见到男主的影。

难道这死亡森林不止这一棵红色的树？

要不出去转转？

时笙出去转了一圈，没见着有其他红色的树，倒是遇到了几只勉强正常的灵兽，等她解决完那几只灵兽，一回到之前的地方，就见那棵树尸体旁边倒着一个人。

哎哟，我去……

原来需要本宝宝回避啊！

时笙摸出玉箫临走前给她的长剑，几步走到那个人跟前，麻溜的朝着他后背刺下去。

“噗……”

“住手！”

这两个声音是同时响起的，前面是长剑刺入肉体的声音，后面是女子清冷的呵斥声。

时笙保持着刺入姿势，偏头朝着声源处看去，眉毛微挑，“哎哟，这不是叶师妹吗？”

叶清秋一袭紫色道袍，道袍上满是污垢，头发乱糟糟，唯独那张脸，干干净净，绝色倾城，眸子里透着一股凌厉张扬的冰冷。

“你在做什么？”叶清秋冷声质问。

“杀人啊，你眼瞎啊！”时笙说得那叫一个理所当然，理直气壮。

“……”这个商殊怎么回事，和一年前完全不一样，难不成也是夺舍重生的？叶清秋眯了眯眸子，“他和你无冤无仇，你无故杀他，会沾上因果报应。”

There are a lot of spiritual beasts in the Death Forest, and their levels are not high. When Shi Sheng encounters them, he just treats them as training, but those spiritual beasts die miserably.

After going all the way in, I finally found the red tree.

It's really red, up and down, inside and out, it's all so red, so gray and dazzling.

Why did she know it was red inside?

Oh, she cut down the tree.

According to its urine properties, this tree should be a special prop, but until Shi Sheng cut it into pieces, there was nothing unusual.

Is it because this baby is not the heroine?Don’t have your own accident body?

Are the routines for props even that deep now?horrible!

Shu: "..." Damn it, you should give it a chance to show off, just cut it down as soon as it comes up, it hasn't reacted yet!

After cutting down the tree, Shi Sheng sat on the tree trunk lying on the ground and looked up at the sky - waiting for the male protagonist!

She only knows that the heroine met the heroine under this tree, but how the hero appeared here is only known by the author.

Shi Sheng waited so long that he almost became a stranger, but he didn't see the male protagonist.

Is there more than just one red tree in this forest of death?

Why don't you go out for a walk?

Shi Sheng went out and walked around, but she didn't see any other red trees. Instead, she encountered a few barely normal spirit beasts. After she finished dealing with those spirit beasts, when she returned to the previous place, she saw a person lying next to the corpse of the tree.

Oops, let me go...

It turns out that this baby needs to be avoided!

Shi Sheng took out the long sword that Yu Xiao had given her before leaving, walked up to the man in a few steps, and stabbed him in the back swiftly.

"Pfft..."

"Stop!"

These two voices sounded at the same time. In the front was the sound of a long sword piercing flesh, and in the back was the woman's cold scolding.

Shi Sheng maintained the thrusting posture, tilted his head and looked towards the source of the sound, raising his eyebrows slightly, "Oh, isn't this Junior Sister Ye?"

Ye Qingqiu wore a purple Taoist robe. The Taoist robe was full of dirt and his hair was messy. But his face was clean and stunning, with a sharp and cold look in his eyes.

"What are you doing?" Ye Qingqiu asked coldly.

"Kill people, you're blind!" Shi Sheng said it so matter-of-factly and confidently.

"..." What happened to this Shang Shu? He was completely different from a year ago. Could it be that he was also reborn?Ye Qingqiu narrowed his eyes, "He has no enmity with you. If you kill him for no reason, you will suffer karma."
